Understanding Multi-Head Attention Mechanisms in Transformer Networks
blogs.content:
Self-attention allows deep neural networks to dynamically weight input tokens regardless of their relative distance. Let's break down Query, Key, and Value matrix multiplications:

$$ Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax\left(\frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)V $$

When scaling to Multi-Head Attention, we project queries, keys, and values $h$ times with separate learned projection matrices. This allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.
